title: Iraq’s Prime Minister Al-Zaidi Vows to Disarm Iran-backed Militias
summary: Ali al-Zaidi is a political neophyte hoping to succeed where previous leaders failed. In an interview, he laid out an ambitious timeline that could prove hard to meet.
